description: Revert to the stable 8-layer architecture with Matrix LR 0.06 and Weight Decay 0.1, which consistently achieved the lowest val_bpb (~0.9905), as the recent stabilization attempt (0.055 LR / 0.12 WD) yielded a slightly worse result (0.9902), suggesting the model requires slightly more aggressive updates to fully converge within the 5-minute budget.
